clues.source: 317 Demagnetized Door Plate · Lower Corridor wall
clues.text: The old plate still shows 317. The name field is wiped white, the bottom edge carries a faint serial code, and there's an irregular notch on the right.
Ash says he pried the plate off 317 himself; the right-side notch dates from the removal. The rest of its handling history is still unclear.
Mira's excerpt of the public unit registry keeps 317's resident index and the plate's serial code, but no name was copied. A margin note says N-07 can check the name index.

N-07 cross-checked the plate's serial code, the old records, and Ash's testimony, confirming the former resident linked to 317 is Eden, registered occupation: cleaner. The rest of its handling history is still unclear.

choices.text: That 317 plate by the door — do you recognize it?
Write down the testimony, then check the old records in 404.
Back to what we were discussing.

ash.text: Something up? I was just checking the repairs over here.

replies.text: Sure do. I pried it off 317 myself — that notch on the right is from the removal. Want to verify who it belonged to? Check the old records Mira left on the desk back in 404, then find N-07. Write down what I just told you first.
The plate's mine — pried it off 317, notch and all. You've already written that down. Just follow the task prompts: check the old records, get N-07 to verify.

door_tag.text: Take a look at that 317 plate on the wall first — note the serial code and the notch, then come find me. It's right of the 404 exit; follow the gold marker.

choices.text: Note the serial code and notch, then go ask Ash.
Take the plate down and bring it back to 404 for storage.

replies.text: N-07 has verified the plate's provenance and suggests bringing the original back to 404 for storage. Once confirmed, take the plate off the wall, put it in your backpack, then return to the locker on the north side of 404.
You've noted the serial code and the notch. Leave the plate on the wall for now; press T for the next step and follow the gold marker to continue the investigation.

low-deck.door-tag-317.text: An old door plate hangs on the wall: 317. The name field is wiped white, a faint serial code runs along the bottom edge, and there's a notch on the right. Note these details, then ask Ash nearby.

choices.text: Got it, I'll follow the guidance.

replies.text: The 317 plate is stored in the north locker. The observation, testimony, old records, and verification are all kept; this is storage only — ownership and public-use rights are unchanged.
The plate is in your backpack. Go to the storage locker at the north-center of the room and press E to choose “Store the plate.” Once the original is in, this introductory investigation is complete.
Verified: the former resident linked to the plate is Eden, registered occupation: cleaner. Next, take the lower exit back to the corridor, remove the 317 plate, and bring it to the north locker.
You brought the plate's serial code and notch, Ash's removal testimony, and Mira's 317 resident index. That's everything. Shall I cross-check them against my name index?
Still need one more record. Go to the desk on the right side of the room, stand below it, examine the paper marked with a gold !, and note 317's index.
The plate's details are noted. Next, find Ash in the corridor, ask about the 317 plate, and make sure his testimony is written down.

n07.text: Head out the lower exit to the corridor and examine the 317 plate on the wall right of the door. The gold ! marks your current objective; exits are marked when the target is in another room. Press E up close, T for full guidance — no need to press R to wait.

replies.text: Storage record: the 317 plate is in this locker, held by 404 for now. N-07's verification is kept with it; former resident Eden's ownership and public-use rights are unchanged.
Place the 317 plate from your backpack into this slot, registered as 404 storage? Confirming moves the original from backpack to locker.

unit-404.cabinet.text: The locker on the north side of 404 has an empty slot. First follow the task prompts to trace the plate's provenance, get N-07's verification, then bring the original back for storage.

choices.text: Note 317's index and serial code, then find N-07.

replies.text: 317's resident index and serial code are copied down; the original stays on the desk. N-07 is at the upper right of the room; press T to review the investigation so far.

unit-404.old-record.text: A page of old unit records, corner-marked “Mira's excerpt / public unit registry”. 317 keeps its resident index and the plate's serial code; no name was copied. A margin note reads: “N-07 can check the name index.”

items.description: An old door plate taken from the corridor wall. The name field is wiped blank, with a notch on the right edge. N-07 has confirmed its link to former resident Eden; awaiting storage in the Cabin 404 locker.
items.name: 317 Demagnetized Door Plate

tasks.background: You've arrived at Cabin 404, left behind by Mira. Outside the door hangs an old 317 plate with its name wiped blank. Its provenance is unclear.

completion.background: You examined the 317 plate, heard Ash's account of the removal, read the old records Mira left behind, and had N-07 verify the former resident's identity as Eden. Then you took the plate down and stored the original in the north locker of 404.
completion.description: Intro investigation complete. The plate is stored by 404; the original is no longer in your backpack. Ownership and public-use rights are unchanged. You can review the storage record in the locker, or press 2 to revisit the investigation clues in slot 1.

tasks.description: Follow the gold markers step by step. ! means go inspect or take; ? means find someone to confirm or deliver; when the target is in another room, the marker points at the exit first. Press E up close, T for full background and current step. No waiting needed.

steps.background: You've just arrived at Cabin 404. The old plate outside shows only a clear 317; the name is wiped blank. Start with the object itself.
steps.description: Take the lower exit to the Lower Corridor and stand on the walkway below the plate, right of the exit. Press E at the gold ! and choose “Note the serial code and notch, then go ask Ash.”
steps.text: Step 1: Leave 404 and examine the 317 plate on the wall right of the door

steps.background: You've noted the 317 plate's faint serial code and right-side notch; the name is unreadable. Ash nearby may know where these marks came from.
steps.description: Head right from the plate to Ash under the gold ?. Press E up close, choose “That 317 plate by the door — do you recognize it?”, then after listening choose “Write down the testimony, then check the old records in 404.”
steps.text: Step 2: Find Ash in the corridor, ask about the plate, and record his testimony

steps.background: The plate's serial code and notch are noted. Ash admits he pried the plate off 317, notch and all; he pointed you to the old records Mira left in 404.
steps.description: Enter 404 by the plate. Go below the desk on the room's right side, press E at the paper marked with a gold !, and choose “Note 317's index and serial code, then find N-07.”
steps.text: Step 3: Return to 404 and read the former-resident records on the right-side desk

steps.background: You've examined the plate, taken Ash's removal testimony, and copied 317's resident index from Mira's public registry excerpt. Three pieces in hand, but the former resident's name is still unconfirmed.
steps.description: Head up from the desk to N-07 under the gold ? at the room's upper right. Press E up close and choose “Please verify these records.” Just opening the dialogue won't advance anything.
steps.text: Step 4: Find N-07 at the upper right of 404 and verify the three pieces

steps.background: N-07 has matched the plate's features, Ash's testimony, and the old records: the former resident is Eden, registered occupation: cleaner. The rest of its handling is still unclear; N-07 suggests bringing the original back to 404 for safekeeping.
steps.description: Take the lower exit from 404 back to the corridor. Press E at the gold ! under the right-hand wall and choose “Take the plate down and bring it back to 404 for storage.” Press 1 to check your backpack after; the plate will be gone from the wall.
steps.text: Step 5: Return to the corridor and take down the 317 plate

steps.background: You've confirmed Eden's identity through the plate, the testimony, and the old records, and taken the 317 plate off the wall into your backpack. Now the physical handoff needs completing — not just a promise to keep it.
steps.description: Return to 404 and stand before the wide locker at the room's north-center. Press E at the gold ? and choose “Store the plate.” The intro investigation completes once the original moves from backpack to locker.
steps.text: Step 6: Return to 404 and place the plate in the north-center storage locker
